vBRIEFInfo.description: Auto-synthesized minimal plan for PAN-2404: bug(cli): pan start --auto synthesizes unfixable acceptance criteria from narrative issue-body bullets — verification gate burns all 3 cycles on them

plan.title: bug(cli): pan start --auto synthesizes unfixable acceptance criteria from narrative issue-body bullets — verification gate burns all 3 cycles on them
plan.author: overdeck/auto-start

narratives.Problem:
## Observed (2026-07-05, PAN-2386 tiered test-drive)

`pan start PAN-2386 --auto` synthesized the minimal vBRIEF by scraping the issue body's bullet lists into acceptance criteria. PAN-2386's body is an incident writeup, so the resulting 8 "AC" included pure evidence pointers that no code change can ever satisfy, e.g.:

- `~/.overdeck/agents/agent-min-857/lifecycle.log (refusal event, 2026-07-05T18:37:40Z)`
- `Workspace: /home/eltmon/Projects/myn/workspaces/feature-min-857 (scaffold repo on master, ...)`
- `[deacon] Error coordinating swarm MIN-857: Command failed: git branch --list ...` (a quoted log line)

The work agent (haiku, tier-1) implemented the real fixes, but the `vbrief-ac` verification check requires every AC row complete — so it failed 3/3 cycles on criteria that are not criteria, generating three feedback files and three fix-resubmit round-trips before the gate's max-cycle bypass let review proceed. Wasted agent cycles + noisy feedback, and a cheaper model could easily have spiraled trying to "complete" a log path.

## Root cause

Auto-start's vBRIEF synthesis treats every `- ` bullet in the issue body as an acceptance criterion. Narrative sections (Observed, Evidence, Context) are indistinguishable from real criteria in that heuristic.

## Fix directions

1. Only synthesize AC from an explicit `## Acceptance`/`## Acceptance criteria` section when one exists; otherwise synthesize a single generic AC ("issue's stated fix implemented with tests") rather than scraping bullets.
2. Never turn bullets containing file paths, log excerpts, or timestamps into AC (cheap heuristics: leading `~/`, `/home/`, `[deacon]`, ISO timestamps).
3. The vbrief-ac verification failure message should say WHICH synthesis produced the AC so the operator can tell auto-synthesized junk from planned criteria.

## Acceptance

- Auto-starting an issue whose body has narrative bullets but an explicit Acceptance section yields only that section's AC.
- Auto-starting an issue with no Acceptance section yields one generic AC, not scraped bullets.
- Regression test for both.
